text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary swap failure for service 'llm-ingress' in prod-us-east — error rate spike (5xx) detected. Trigger: canary-traffic-swap. PagerDuty: paged @carmen_oncall.

carmen_oncall: I'm on it. seeing ~8% 5xx for /v1/generate on the canary pods. canary replicas are crashlooping. pulling logs.

alice_sre: heads up — HPA reacted, scaled canary up then nodes started evicting non-canary pods, some drained nodes hit memory pressure. possible manifest change in rollout (sidecar env?)

carmen_oncall: logs show OOMKilled in canary container shortly after init: missing ENV MY_CACHE_DIR -> segfault in startup. new image has different default memory usage.

ben_prodeng: that image was pushed as part of the rapid rollout at ~1745678800. feature flag swap toggled traffic to canary. I can toggle feature flag off if we want an immediate kill-switch.

eva_support: customers reporting timeouts in EU. severity elevated. currently ~12% requests failing for some tenants.

dave_reliability: recommend immediate mitigation: pause traffic swap (feature flag -> off), then rollback deployment to previous revision, then scale down canary RS.

carmen_oncall: doing the flag toggle now. calling the config service: POST /flags/llm_swap -> {"enabled":false} .. done. :white_check_mark: Routing reverted to stable.

incident-bot: ACTION: feature flag "llm_swap" set to false by carmen_oncall.

alice_sre: rolling back deployment to revision 42. running: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/llm-ingress --to-revision=42

alice_sre: rollout undo started. verifying pod readiness...

dave_reliability: also temporarily scale down HPA for canary to avoid eviction churn: kubectl -n prod scale deployment/llm-ingress-canary --replicas=0 || kubectl -n prod patch hpa/llm-ingress-canary -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":0}}'

alice_sre: canary RS scaled to 0. stable pods coming back healthy. 5xxs trending down.

ben_prodeng: pushed notification to affected customers and updated status page draft.

eva_support: confirm reduced customer impact: monitoring shows 5xx back to baseline (~0.3%). tenants with timeouts cleared.

carmen_oncall: handing off to dave_reliability for postmortem/next steps. I'll update the PD incident with timeline.

dave_reliability: taking over. next steps: capture diffs between images (memory footprint), check release pipeline gating for env var changes, add canary resource constraints + preflight check for ENV compat. assigning follow-ups to ben and alice.

ben_prodeng: I'll add a kill-switch runbook and tighten the rollout window; also revert the rapid-swap automation until preflight exists.

alice_sre: will open a PR to add a manifests check to CI (verify required env vars) and add memory request/limit enforcement for canaries.

dave_reliability: incident severity -> SEV2. Postmortem owner: dave_reliability. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow. closing live incident channel.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated. PagerDuty incident acknowledged -> resolved by carmen_oncall at 1745678932.

carmen_oncall: thanks team. good recovery. :bow: 

dave_reliability: closing thread once postmortem link posted.
